## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List commands run and any checks not executed. For skill behavior changes, include
synthetic evidence and assertions; identify whether model evaluation is warranted.

## Risks

Describe compatibility, credential handling, package or workflow permission changes.

- [ ] Branch, commits and PR title follow the contribution policy.
- [ ] Relative references and independent packaging pass.
- [ ] No credentials or production mutations are introduced.
- [ ] Changes to workflows, validation, locks and governance received careful review.
